name: Littlestone Dimension
definition: For a finite Boolean class $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, $\operatorname{Ldim}(H)$ is the largest height of a complete binary decision tree whose internal nodes are labeled by coordinates of $X$ and for which every root-to-leaf answer sequence is realized by a concept of $H$.
codomain: Nonnegative integers for nonempty finite classes
normalization: A nonempty class has Littlestone dimension zero exactly when it is a singleton; the empty class is conventionally assigned dimension $-1$ when needed.
comments: This adaptive shattering dimension differs from VC dimension, which uses a fixed coordinate set.
